_README_: Furgenics theme settings additions for the discount-banner snippet.
Shopify admin → Online Store → Themes → Edit code → config/settings_schema.json
The settings_schema.json file is a TOP-LEVEL JSON ARRAY. Each element is a 'section'
of theme settings. Paste the object below AS A NEW ELEMENT in that array — typically
near the end, before the 'theme_info' section if one exists.
After pasting and saving, the new settings appear in Theme Editor → Customize →
Theme settings → 'Active Discount Campaign' section. Stephen edits values there;
the discount-banner snippet renders them automatically across all pages.
DO NOT include this _README_ field in the live theme — copy only the section object
below (the one starting with 'name: Active Discount Campaign').

settings.info: Controls the discount-banner snippet rendered across pages (PDPs, pillars, Groomer Program). Update here, and every page reflects the new code instantly.

settings.label: Show discount banner site-wide
settings.info: Uncheck to hide the banner everywhere without removing the code.

settings.label: Discount code
settings.info: Must match an active discount in Settings → Discounts. e.g. FUR50, FUR20, SUMMER25.

settings.label: Max units per order (optional)
settings.info: Renders 'Max N gallons per order' in the banner. Leave 0 to omit.

settings.label: Eligibility note (optional)
settings.info: Free-form clause. Leave empty to omit.

settings.label: Banner headline (optional)
settings.info: Optional bold headline above the banner copy. e.g. 'Spring Sale' or 'Limited time'.
